narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the diagonals cannot be equal, because one slants up and the other slants down.
<bookmark mark='slant'/>A line can slant in a different direction and still have the same length as another.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Guessing from the look is risky, so we measure both diagonals carefully.

<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Draw a rectangle twelve centimetres long and nine centimetres wide, and measure both diagonals. Are they equal?
